package nats

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

const PlanningStateStream = "STUDENT_PLANNING_STATE_EVENTS"
const HybridReplanDurable = "ms-learning-planner-hybrid-replan-v1"
const PlanningStateRetryDelay = 2 * time.Second

type PlanningStateProcessor interface {
	ReceivePlanningStateEvent(context.Context, domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent) (bool, error)
}

// DecodePlanningStateMessage admits only the exact owner subject and
// mandatory single-valued headers matching the strict envelope.
func DecodePlanningStateMessage(message *natsgo.Msg) (domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent, error) {
	if message == nil || message.Subject != domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged {
		return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	headerBytes := 0
	headerValues := 0
	if len(message.Header) > 32 {
		return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for key, values := range message.Header {
		headerBytes += len(key)
		headerValues += len(values)
		if headerValues > 64 {
			return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		for _, value := range values {
			headerBytes += len(value)
		}
		if headerBytes > 8192 {
			return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	event, err := domain.DecodePlanningStateChangedEvent(message.Data)
	if err != nil {
		return event, err
	}
	expected := map[string]string{"X-Event-ID": event.EventID, "X-Correlation-ID": event.CorrelationID, "X-Causation-ID": event.CausationID, "X-Schema-Version": "1"}
	for name, value := range expected {
		count := 0
		for key, values := range message.Header {
			if strings.EqualFold(key, name) {
				count += len(values)
				if len(values) != 1 || values[0] != value {
					return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
				}
			}
		}
		if count != 1 {
			return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	for key, values := range message.Header {
		if strings.EqualFold(key, natsgo.MsgIdHdr) && (len(values) != 1 || values[0] != event.EventID) {
			return domain.PlanningStateChangedEvent{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	return event, nil
}

type planningStateDelivery interface {
	AckSync(...natsgo.AckOpt) error
	Term(...natsgo.AckOpt) error
	NakWithDelay(time.Duration, ...natsgo.AckOpt) error
}

// HandlePlanningStateMessage acknowledges only an immutable durable inbox
// receipt; malformed/reference-mismatched messages terminate without mutation.
func HandlePlanningStateMessage(ctx context.Context, message *natsgo.Msg, processor PlanningStateProcessor) error {
	if message == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return handlePlanningStateDelivery(ctx, message, processor, message)
}

func handlePlanningStateDelivery(ctx context.Context, message *natsgo.Msg, processor PlanningStateProcessor, delivery planningStateDelivery) error {
	event, err := DecodePlanningStateMessage(message)
	if err == nil {
		metadata, metadataErr := message.Metadata()
		if metadataErr != nil || metadata.Stream != PlanningStateStream || metadata.Consumer != HybridReplanDurable {
			err = domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if err == nil {
		if processor == nil {
			err = domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
		} else {
			_, err = processor.ReceivePlanningStateEvent(ctx, event)
		}
	}
	if err == nil {
		return delivery.AckSync(natsgo.Context(ctx))
	}
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict) || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden) {
		if terminalErr := delivery.Term(); terminalErr != nil {
			return terminalErr
		}
	} else if retryErr := delivery.NakWithDelay(PlanningStateRetryDelay); retryErr != nil {
		return retryErr
	}
	return err
}

// PlanningStateConsumer owns its connection, context, and one pull loop.
// It binds the durable without resetting or changing any shared stream.
type PlanningStateConsumer struct {
	connection   *natsgo.Conn
	subscription *natsgo.Subscription
	cancel       context.CancelFunc
	done         chan struct{}
	closeOnce    sync.Once
}

// NewPlanningStateConsumer uses the existing NATS_URL configuration. Startup
// fails unless infrastructure provisioned the dedicated lossless workqueue.
func NewPlanningStateConsumer(ctx context.Context, url string, processor PlanningStateProcessor) (*PlanningStateConsumer, error) {
	if ctx == nil || strings.TrimSpace(url) == "" || processor == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	connection, err := natsgo.Connect(url, natsgo.Name(HybridReplanDurable), natsgo.Timeout(5*time.Second), natsgo.MaxReconnects(-1), natsgo.ReconnectWait(time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	succeeded := false
	defer func() {
		if !succeeded {
			connection.Close()
		}
	}()
	js, err := connection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	startup, cancelStartup := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)
	defer cancelStartup()
	stream, err := js.StreamInfo(PlanningStateStream, natsgo.Context(startup))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("planning state stream required: %w", err)
	}
	if err = validatePlanningStateStream(stream.Config); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := js.ConsumerInfo(PlanningStateStream, HybridReplanDurable, natsgo.Context(startup))
	if errors.Is(err, natsgo.ErrConsumerNotFound) {
		info, err = js.AddConsumer(PlanningStateStream, &natsgo.ConsumerConfig{Durable: HybridReplanDurable, FilterSubject: domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, DeliverPolicy: natsgo.DeliverAllPolicy, AckPolicy: natsgo.AckExplicitPolicy, AckWait: 30 * time.Second, MaxDeliver: -1, MaxAckPending: 1, MaxWaiting: 128}, natsgo.Context(startup))
		// Concurrent service starts may race to create the same fixed durable.
		if err != nil {
			info, err = js.ConsumerInfo(PlanningStateStream, HybridReplanDurable, natsgo.Context(startup))
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = validatePlanningStateConsumer(info.Config); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	subscription, err := js.PullSubscribe(domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged, HybridReplanDurable, natsgo.Bind(PlanningStateStream, HybridReplanDurable), natsgo.ManualAck())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	runContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	consumer := &PlanningStateConsumer{connection: connection, subscription: subscription, cancel: cancel, done: make(chan struct{})}
	succeeded = true
	go consumer.run(runContext, processor)
	return consumer, nil
}

func validatePlanningStateStream(config natsgo.StreamConfig) error {
	if config.Name != PlanningStateStream || len(config.Subjects) != 1 || config.Subjects[0] != domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged || config.Retention != natsgo.WorkQueuePolicy || config.Storage != natsgo.FileStorage || config.MaxAge != 0 || config.MaxMsgs != -1 || config.MaxBytes != 1<<30 || config.Discard != natsgo.DiscardNew || config.Replicas != 1 || config.MaxMsgsPerSubject > 0 || config.Duplicates != 10*time.Minute {
		return errors.New("planning state stream contract mismatch")
	}
	return nil
}
func validatePlanningStateConsumer(config natsgo.ConsumerConfig) error {
	if config.Durable != HybridReplanDurable || config.FilterSubject != domain.SubjectPlanningStateChanged || config.DeliverPolicy != natsgo.DeliverAllPolicy || config.AckPolicy != natsgo.AckExplicitPolicy || config.MaxDeliver != -1 || config.DeliverSubject != "" || config.AckWait != 30*time.Second || config.MaxAckPending != 1 {
		return errors.New("hybrid replanning durable contract mismatch")
	}
	return nil
}
func (c *PlanningStateConsumer) run(ctx context.Context, processor PlanningStateProcessor) {
	defer close(c.done)
	for ctx.Err() == nil {
		fetchContext, cancelFetch := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Second)
		messages, err := c.subscription.Fetch(1, natsgo.Context(fetchContext))
		cancelFetch()
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return
		}
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, natsgo.ErrTimeout) || errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
				continue
			}
			timer := time.NewTimer(PlanningStateRetryDelay)
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				timer.Stop()
				return
			case <-timer.C:
			}
			continue
		}
		for _, message := range messages {
			processContext, cancelProcess := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
			_ = HandlePlanningStateMessage(processContext, message, processor)
			cancelProcess()
		}
	}
}

func (c *PlanningStateConsumer) Close() {
	if c == nil {
		return
	}
	c.closeOnce.Do(func() { c.cancel(); <-c.done; _ = c.subscription.Unsubscribe(); c.connection.Close() })
}
